svg.title: Guo System Defence Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 136-137, PDF 137-138. Complete single-deck envelope preserves flat forward nose, chamfered broad forward hull, subtle side steps and long taper toward squared aft drives. Illustration corroborates long armoured vessel with wider forward accommodation. Missile-bay and engineering room borders excluded; no detached turrets added.
